{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter to only completed orders (not refunded)
df_final = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Group by channel and sum revenue
df_revenue_by_channel = df_final.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_clean'].sum()

df_revenue_by_channel"}
